The sound of birds chirping outside echoed through the spacious, well-appointed mountain lodge. It was a beautiful day, and the sun gleamed through the large windows, casting a warm glow over the room. 

Sitting at a large table in the center of the lodge were three men: Jin, Sebastian, and Kazuma. All three were built like statues, with bodies as hard and toned as marble. The combination of their size and their physical prowess was striking, almost intimidating, and they stood out in this beautiful setting like lions among sheep. 

They had been assigned to protect you as personally bodyguards after your father's assassination, and they were your only connection to the outside world now.
